{{AnimeLocationInfobox |name=Village of Dragons |image=Village of Dragons.png |characters=竜の里 |japanese=Village of Dragons |imagesize=250px |region=Unova |epicode=BW009 |episode=The Bloom is on Axew! }} The '''Village of Dragons''' (Japanese: '''{{tt|竜|りゅう}}の{{tt|里|さと}}''' ''Village of Dragons'') is a location in the [[Pokémon world]], first mentioned in {{aniseries|BW}}. ==In animation== [[File:Young Iris farewell.png|thumb|left|250px|Young Iris leaving the Village of Dragons for Opelucid School]] ===''Pokémon the Series''=== ===={{aniseries|BW}}==== In {{aniseries|PTS}}, the Village of Dragons is a village in the [[Unova]] [[region]] located near [[Opelucid City]]. It is the [[hometown]] of {{an|Iris}} and [[Shannon]]. The Village of Dragons is a place where people raise and admire {{type|Dragon}} {{OBP|Pokémon|species}}. An {{OBP|elder|Village of Dragons}} who lives there will also give out a Dragon-type Pokémon for {{pkmn|Trainer}}s to {{pkmn|training|raise}}. It was first mentioned by Iris in ''[[BW009|The Bloom Is on Axew!]]'' when she explained how she obtained her {{TP|Iris|Axew}}. Statues of the {{pkmn2|Legendary}} {{p|Reshiram}} and {{p|Zekrom}} were built in the center of the village to commemorate them. Dragon Pokémon roam around the village freely, such as Axew and its evolved form, {{p|Fraxure}}. Not all the Pokémon here are Dragon type though: other Pokémon such as {{p|Drilbur}} living in the surrounding forests. Every year, there is a [[Pokémon battle]] tournament that Iris and her {{TP|Iris|Excadrill}} were seen competing at. Iris competed in it one time and did very well. She felt confident enough to challenge [[Opelucid City]] [[Gym Leader]] [[Drayden]] to a battle, but Drayden and his {{p|Haxorus}} easily overpowered her and won. According to Iris, most people from the village dream to become a [[Type expert|Dragon Master]]. Following on Iris's suggestion, the group visited the village in ''[[BW100|A Village Homecoming!]]''. Iris caught up with the village elder, who gave a positive evaluation of her and Axew's progress. Iris's childhood friend Shannon was revealed to be training to become a {{tc|Pokémon Breeder}}, and she was currently raising two {{p|Zweilous}}. However, one of the Zweilous [[Evolution|evolved]] into a {{p|Hydreigon}} and began to panic. Iris and her Pokémon worked together to calm the Dragon-type down, and her efforts caught the attention of Drayden, who invited Iris to challenge the Opelucid Gym. ====Pokémon seen in the Village of In [[Pokémon X and Y]], an {{tc|Ace Trainer}} in the [[Lumiose City]] {{FB|Lumiose|Museum}} gives the {{player}} {{TM|82|Dragon Tail}} and mentions that his partner learned the move in the Village of Dragons. ==In the manga== ===Pokémon Adventures=== ===={{MangaArc|Black & White}}==== In ''[[PS516|One Way or Another]]'', during the {{un|Pokémon League}} tournament battle between {{adv|Black}} and Iris, she revealed that her hometown, the Village of Dragons, is in fact [[Blackthorn City]] in the [[Johto]] region. It is also where she had first met Drayden, who had taken her to the Unova region to train with him. ==Trivia== * In the animated series, the Village of Dragons is located in Unova, near Opelucid City. In the games, it is stated to be in a remote region far away from Unova. ** According to the [[Pokémon Adventures]] {{pkmn|manga}}, the Village of Dragons is Blackthorn City in Johto, a place known for its long history with Dragon Pokémon. ==In other languages== {{langtable|color={{white color}}|bordercolor={{black color}} |zh_cmn=龍之鄉 ''Lóng zhī Xiāng'' |cs=Dračí vesnice |da=Dragernes By |nl=Drakendorp |fi=Lohikäärmekylä |fr=Village des Dragons |de=Dorf der Drachen |hi=ड्रेगन का गांव ''Dragons ka Gaon'' |id=Desa Naga |it=Villaggio dei Draghi |ko=용의 고을 ''Yong-ui Goeul'' |no=Dragelandsby |ms=Village of Dragons |pl=Wioska Smoków |pt=Vila dos Dragões |ru=Деревня Драконов ''Derevnya Drakonov'' |es=Aldea de los Dragones |sv=Drakebyn
